INSERT INTO run_command (tenant_id, run_id, run_node_id, command_seq, method, payload, status, attempt, sent_at, finished_at, result, device_raw_response, error_code, device_id) SELECT #{param1}, #{param2}, rn.id, 1, #{param4}, #{param5}::jsonb, #{param7}::node_status, 0, COALESCE(#{param8}::timestamptz, now()), CASE WHEN #{param7}::text = 'running' THEN NULL ELSE now() END, jsonb_build_object('note', #{param6}::text), to_jsonb(#{param6}::text), NULL, NULL FROM (SELECT id FROM run_node WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND run_id = #{param2} AND node_key = #{param3} AND level = 0 AND loop_index = 0 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) rn ON CONFLICT (run_node_id, command_seq, attempt) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, -- ⚠ **不要动 sent_at**：它是**开始**时刻。 -- 内置节点要先插一行 running（sent_at = 开始），结束时再 upsert 一次； -- 若这里把 sent_at 一起更新，就会被冲成**完成**时刻 -- ⇒ 台账上「延时 60 秒」显示成「耗时 0.1 秒」 -- （2026-11-11 现场发现：sleep 真睡了 60 秒，台账说 0.1 秒）。 finished_at = EXCLUDED.finished_at, result = EXCLUDED.result, device_raw_response = EXCLUDED.device_raw_response
